## Validation and handoff

The 20 screened development records were all retrieved: **100% relative recall against that development set**. No user-supplied seeds, held-out validation set, or benchmark set were available, so recall is not independently validated and is not a sensitivity estimate.

The malaria category probes found no records outside the condition block. The broader RDT probe screened 30 records and found no eligible records outside the test block; a sample of that size cannot rule out all unusual product-specific wording. Endemic setting, uncomplicated severity, reference standard, and reported accuracy remain screening criteria.

The internal critique passed in two same-context rounds because a fresh reviewer session was unavailable. This is not independent PRESS peer review. **An information specialist should PRESS peer review this draft before use.**
